opening.argument: The instructional purpose is clear from the specific skateboarding guidance and demonstrations. The speaker advises viewers to learn quarter pipes, explains that he knows how to set up a skateboard, and breaks down the movements required for an ollie: “You just need to snap the tail. And then slide your front foot simultaneously.” The description likewise identifies instruction on skateboard setup, griptape, ollies, boardslides, and other techniques. The request to subscribe is ordinary channel engagement, with no connection to payment, investment, credential submission, or another deceptive participation flow.

citations.quote: My first advice to you is learn how to skate quarter pipes
I do know how to set up a skateboard.
You just need to snap the tail. And then slide your front foot simultaneously. To bring the tail up, that's an ollie.
Tony also demonstrates how to set up a new skateboard, how to apply griptape, how to do an ollie, how to boardslide, how to do a 540° McTwist and more.
